issue_context.title: adaptive sync load concurrency
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

The current implementation of our synchronization mechanism under high load scenarios tends to exhibit less-than-optimal concurrency performance. This issue aims to enhance the adaptive sync load mechanism to better handle concurrent operations, thereby improving throughput and reducing latency under varying load conditions.
